About

A researcher's mindset, an educator's voice

I am pursuing an M.Sc. in Statistics and Data Analytics at Lovely Professional University, after completing an Integrated B.Sc. B.Ed. My work connects rigorous quantitative methods, from ARIMA forecasting to extreme value theory, with classroom experience, so I can analyse data and also communicate it to any audience.

Research

Publications

Scopus-indexedMar 2026

Robust Statistical Methods for Detecting Outliers, Anomalies, and Structural Instability in Econometric Data

Chapter 4 (pp. 107–133) in Robust Methods for Anomaly Detection in Econometrics · IGI Global Scientific Publishing · with Manzoor Ahmad Khanday · DOI 10.4018/979-8-3373-8297-5.ch004

  • Built a robust framework for macroeconomic and financial data with outliers, heavy tails and structural breaks.
  • Applied Extreme Value Theory, break detection and robust estimation to Nifty-50 returns.
  • On Nifty-50 returns (1995–2023, 6,898 daily observations), the robust MAD rule flagged 281 extreme days versus 104 for the classical three-sigma rule.
Communicated · Apr 2026

A Time Series Driven AI Tutors for Adaptive Learning in Modeling Learning Dynamics and Personalized Interventions

Book chapter · with Rakesh Kumar · Lovely Professional University

  • Multiple regression of final marks on attendance, internal scores, assignments and study hours.
  • Stage-based time-series framework across Internal Tests, Assignment and Final Exam.
  • Moving averages and ARIMA forecasts with confidence intervals, implemented in R (dplyr, ggplot2, forecast).
Book chapter manuscript

Statistical Auditing of Algorithmic Fairness in Public-Sector Decision-Making as a Quantitative Framework for Institutional Accountability

Book chapter

  • Built a reproducible auditing pipeline: descriptive disparity, chi-square tests, logistic regression and group-wise error rates.
  • On the Adult Income (Census) data, 31.4% of men versus 11.4% of women were high-income (four-fifths ratio 0.36).
  • A classifier looked more accurate for women (88.5% vs 77.0%) yet missed more high-income women (false-negative rate 65.1% vs 60.7%), showing how aggregate accuracy hides unequal errors.
May 2024

Sugar Alcohols & Vitamin B7 in Aqueous Solutions

Book chapter · Lovely Professional University

  • Volumetric and acoustic study of sugar alcohol interactions with Vitamin B7.
  • Analysed variation with temperature to understand solution behaviour and molecular interactions.

Selected work

Python · Plotly · ARIMAApr 2026

Crude Oil Prices: Pre-War vs War/Conflict Period

Statistical analysis & time-series forecasting

  • Split daily WTI and Brent prices into pre-war and conflict phases and compared their behaviour.
  • Used descriptive statistics, independent t-tests, volatility analysis and distribution comparisons.
  • Fitted ARIMA models to forecast both benchmarks under a continued-conflict scenario, with confidence intervals.
  • Built interactive Plotly visualisations of trends, distributions, daily % changes and forecasts.
